observation_method: Read-only host process listing during the actual held-out run
finding: A separate local MLX workload was active on the same host while the study was generating a long response. Completed study steps and token streams continued to advance.
scope: Single observational sample, not a measurement of contention duration or attributable overhead
action: The unrelated workload was not modified; the frozen study continued under its original model, decoding, budgets and verifier rules.
interpretation: Shared-host activity is a confound for latency comparisons; recorded timing is observed wall/runtime telemetry, not an isolated-hardware performance benchmark. No claim is made that this activity caused any particular model outcome.
